entities.summary: Joseph Jonathan Delisle was a Canadian professional ice hockey right winger. He played one game in the National Hockey League with the Montreal Canadiens during the 1998–99 season. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1997 to 2006, was spent in the minor leagues.
